notes: Summary: LumenByte builds a VS Code extension (LumenAssist) used by internal engineering and early customers. Primary value prop: low-latency streaming inline completions + deterministic model pinning for reproducible suggestions.
Product constraints: must support per-user rate limits (free tier internally + paid plans), token-level usage reporting in console, and offline caching of small completion contexts.
Security: Okta SSO (SAML) is mandatory; legal requires SOC2 attestation and audit logs for all prompt/response access; customer data retention policy strict (30d default).
Technical ask: streaming API with chunked responses over websockets or SSE, ability to pin model version and an option to fallback to a smaller local model when latency spikes.
Quote from CTO (call 11/07): 'We need suggestions that feel instant — <100ms median. If tail latency or cost is unpredictable we can't ship to customers.'
POC notes: Using internal telemetry, saw token burn on repetitive completion requests — wants intelligent caching/prefix reuse (possible Redwood Optimize fit).
Billing concern: wants per-request and per-token breakdown grouped by extension route (inline vs code-complete) — asked for token-level cost export (CSV or API).
Edge cases: offline dev machines require partial functionality; exploring tiny local quantized model for fallback (on-device scoring for final rank).
SE action items: run dedicated perf sweep at 16k context, enable KV cache, test routing policy that favors dedicated pool in us-west, return latency profile and price/throughput estimate.
AE notes: strong champion in engineering (Senior Eng Manager Priyanka Rao). Sales signal: high usage expected if POC meets latency & cost targets.
